title: Effect status record (closed quarantine/release state machine)
$comment: Structural residue of the effect.* rules (P0-5). One record per state transition of a quarantine entry under the closed machine (effect.state.closed-machine): RECEIVED → QUARANTINED → EVIDENCE_VERIFIED → RELEASE_AUTHORIZED → DISPATCHING → EFFECT_CONFIRMED | EFFECT_UNKNOWN | EFFECT_FAILED, plus QUARANTINED → DENIED | DENY_EXPIRED. The generation field carries the compare-and-swap fencing token (effect.dispatch.single-flight) as a decimal string. The only success state is EFFECT_CONFIRMED (effect.state.confirmed-only); EFFECT_UNKNOWN is an observation of ambiguity, never a guessed failure (effect.state.unknown-no-retry). $defs are inlined (no cross-file $ref).

generation.$comment: Monotonic per entry; a transition is valid only when it wins the compare-and-swap on this token (effect.dispatch.single-flight).

targetAcknowledgementRef.$comment: Present in EFFECT_CONFIRMED: the reference a receipt binds (effect.receipt.confirmed-only).

reason.$comment: Non-normative operator context (deny reason label, timeout class, etc.).

writerProfile.$comment: effect.writer.capability / .limited-profile: which writer conformance class handled this delivery. Kept in sync with scope-catalog.json writerCapabilityProfile. A limited writer never re-enters DISPATCHING from EFFECT_UNKNOWN.

allOf.$comment: From RELEASE_AUTHORIZED onward the authorization is a mandatory binding (effect.authorization.artifact), not an optional annotation.
A dispatch and every effect outcome are about one delivery (effect.delivery.identity); a record without the identity cannot be deduplicated or reconciled.
EFFECT_CONFIRMED means target confirmation was observed (effect.state.confirmed-only); the acknowledgement reference is what a receipt binds (effect.receipt.confirmed-only).

effectState.$comment: effect.state.closed-machine: the closed set; a deployment adds no members and no transitions.

transitionTable.$comment: effect.state.closed-machine: THE normative transition table (empty list = terminal). EFFECT_UNKNOWN resolves only through target reconciliation (effect.state.unknown-no-retry): a lookup that finds the effect moves to EFFECT_CONFIRMED without re-writing; proof of absence moves to EFFECT_FAILED; DISPATCHING re-entry is allowed only through an idempotency-capable writer path (effect.writer.capability). This $def is a reference table, not an instance validator.

decimalString.$comment: canon.number.safe-integer: fencing token in the string domain, not a JSON number.

deliveryIdentity.$comment: effect.delivery.identity: the minimum discriminator set; an idempotency key coarser than this collapses distinct legitimate deliveries.

deliveryOccurrence.$comment: Quarantine entry id or per-entry occurrence discriminator.
